henry4204aaa-wiki-doc-skill-root.description: 3-level documentation protocol for LLM-assisted codebases. Builds and maintains a structured knowledge base (module index → function index → function docs) that any LLM agent can navigate with minimal context loading. Supports two pass types: doc-only passes (no source edits) and edit-enabled passes (small fixes surfaced during documentation, gated by an explicit suggest-approve-apply-verify-log protocol). Use this skill whenever the user wants to: create documentation for a codebase or module, build a knowledge base from code review sessions, set up structured docs that stay synchronized…
